instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "After my AI has paid, add what it spent to today's and the all-time totals", and give it spend_authority_ref; operation_ref; amount (Whole cents paid).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:record-a-spend and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Adds one paid spend (whole cents) to the spend authority's total for today and for all time, and keeps a record of the payment.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: spend-authority (records:read, records:write); spend-payment (records:read, records:write).
